t: Three things that let a person taste it
a: ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ وَجَدَ حَلاَوَةَ الإِيمَانِ أَنْ يَكُونَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سِوَاهُمَا، وَأَنْ يُحِبَّ الْمَرْءَ لاَ يُحِبُّهُ إِلاَّ لِلَّهِ
p: Thalāthun man kunna fīhi wajada ḥalāwata-l-īmān: an yakūna-Llāhu wa rasūluhu aḥabba ilayhi mimmā siwāhumā, wa an yuḥibba-l-marʾa lā yuḥibbuhu illā lillāh
m: Three things: whoever has them finds the sweetness of faith. That Allah and His Messenger are more beloved to him than anything besides them. And that he loves a person for no reason except Allah.
